# Quests of Helena (Stillwater Crossing)

## Helena (npc 9000000103, Stillwater Crossing): quest dossier

**Result: no unbuilt quest is evidenced for this giver.** Both Stillwater-chef quests Helena gives are already in `quests/chef.json`. The other three ids in `quest_ids_given` are in `quests/fisherman.json`, but their giver field points at this Helena, which the sources contradict (see the conflict below).

### Quests given by the Stillwater Helena

| Quest | Title (locale id) | Built at | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chef: Stillwater Inn | 116477 | `chef.json` id 3050015 (line 819), `giver_npc_id` 9000000103 | Built |
| Chef: Gavin Gone Missing | 116493 | `chef.json` id 3050016 (line 868), prereq 3050015, giver 9000000103 | Built |

Locale text for these two (for the builder's reference; nothing new to add):
- 116477 "Chef: Stillwater Inn". Intro 116476 (per chef.json). Description 116478: "Business at Stillwater Inn has never been better! But Helena is short handed while her assistant is out gathering ingredients. It's a good thing you're here to save the day!"
- 116480 (Helena's cooking-lesson dialogue): "...I'll teach you how to cook Spiralmint Steak, then you can help me catch up on these orders."
- 116493 "Chef: Gavin Gone Missing". Intro 116492: "My assistant is gathering ingredients for me, but he's late..." Description 116494: "Helena's assistant, Gavin Greenpetal has been gone for quite some time. Search for him on the road heading south out of Stillwater Crossing."
- Evidence: `notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Chef.md:101-102` (rows S1, S2, with title ids ucdt 2218586113 / 2734608986); `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Stillwater Crossing.md:129-130`.

Both rows have empty `objectives` and `rewards`, and the reward fields are "unknown" in the guide. Those are gaps in the existing build, not new quests.

### Quests in `quest_ids_given` that are misattributed

Fisherman quests 3070040, 3070043 and 3070045 are built in `quests/fisherman.json` with `giver_npc_id: 9000000103`:
- 3070040 "Fisherman: Plenty of Fish" (title 409040), line 1941, prereq 3070039.
- 3070043 "Fisherman: To the Rescue!" (title 412262), line 2081.

# Quests of Helena (Stillwater Crossing)

## Helena (npc 9000000103, Stillwater Crossing): quest dossier

**Result: no unbuilt quest is evidenced for this giver.** Both Stillwater-chef quests Helena gives are already in `quests/chef.json`. The other three ids in `quest_ids_given` are in `quests/fisherman.json`, but their giver field points at this Helena, which the sources contradict (see the conflict below).

### Quests given by the Stillwater Helena

| Quest | Title (locale id) | Built at | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chef: Stillwater Inn | 116477 | `chef.json` id 3050015 (line 819), `giver_npc_id` 9000000103 | Built |
| Chef: Gavin Gone Missing | 116493 | `chef.json` id 3050016 (line 868), prereq 3050015, giver 9000000103 | Built |

Locale text for these two (for the builder's reference; nothing new to add):

- 116480 (Helena's cooking-lesson dialogue): "...I'll teach you how to cook Spiralmint Steak, then you can help me catch up on these orders."
- 116493 "Chef: Gavin Gone Missing". Intro 116492: "My assistant is gathering ingredients for me, but he's late..." Description 116494: "Helena's assistant, Gavin Greenpetal has been gone for quite some time. Search for him on the road heading south out of Stillwater Crossing."
- Evidence: `notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Chef.md:101-102` (rows S1, S2, with title ids ucdt 2218586113 / 2734608986); `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Stillwater Crossing.md:129-130`.

Both rows have empty `objectives` and `rewards`, and the reward fields are "unknown" in the guide. Those are gaps in the existing build, not new quests.

### Quests in `quest_ids_given` that are misattributed

Fisherman quests 3070040, 3070043 and 3070045 are built in `quests/fisherman.json` with `giver_npc_id: 9000000103`:
- 3070040 "Fisherman: Plenty of Fish" (title 409040), line 1941, prereq 3070039.

- 3070045 "Fisherman: Sunken Treasure" (title 412195), line 2175, prereq 3070044.

The Fisherman guide places these at Wintery Basin with a giver named Helena (`notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Fisherman.md:136, 139, 141`). The NPC guide says this is a different Helena, "treated as two NPCs; unproven" (`NPCs - Stillwater Crossi

The record lists one quest: **3060004**, "Demo Derby: Rules of the Road" (title string 403450). It is already built, so no new dossier is written.

Now I have all this cheery salmon, and no one to feed it to!

Don't worry. I'll still pay you."

q3070018.giver_dossier:
# Quests of Callie Kelpcake (Stillwater Crossing) ## Summary The one quest the record attributes to Callie Kelpcake (npc 9000000041), **Fisherman: Fresh Fish Special** (3070018), is already in `quests/fisherman.json` (lines 904-949), but its locale text belongs to Chef Lucca, not Callie. That built entry should be corrected. The quest Callie's own text actually describes is **Shallows: Catch of the Day** (locale 409716), which is not built. Its giver is still contested, so it is written up below as a candidate. ## 1. Fisherman: Fresh Fish Special (3070018): already built, attribution wrong - **Title:** 410333 "Fisherman: Fresh Fish Special" (locale). - **Intro (410332):** "My customers have pickier palettes than penguins, I'm afraid. I don't use Thornfin in any of my recipes.

Frostgill Smelt has a much better taste when seared. Do you think you'd be any good at reeling those in?" - **Description (410334):** "Chef Lucca has been inspired by your fishing skills! He wants to create a new menu item using Frostgill Smelt and Spiralmint." - **End (410335):** "That's the heartiest dish I've ever had from Lucca. I heard you reeled in the Frostgill yourself.

If that's true, then I wonder why you're not on my team!" - **Giver:** the existing build uses giver_npc_id 9000000041 (Callie). The text names Chef Lucca and Frostgill Smelt, and nothing in the block names Callie. The guide's basis for the Callie link is only a "weak" title match (`notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Fisherman.md:90`, marked †). Lucca's NPC id is not resolved here. - **Steps (from text only):** reel in Frostgill Smelt, then return to Lucca. The objective and turn-in lines were not located, and the Frostgill Smelt and Spiralmint targets are not resolved to item ids. - **Prereqs and rewards:** unknown. - **Evidence:** `locale` 410332-410335; `quests/fisherman.json:904-949`; `notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Fisherman.md:90`. - **Recommendation:** re-attribute this entry to Lucca once his NPC record is checked, and remove Callie from its giver field and from the Stillwater NPC record's `quest_ids_given`. ## 2. Shallows: Catch of the Day (candidate for Callie; not built) - **Title:** 409716 "Shallows: Catch of the Day". locale:409452 "Whatever those fisherment are up, it can't be good. Hogging the entire end of the Bayou like that is unfair!

Whatever they're catching down there must be good. You look like the adventurous type. Would you be up for a little eavesdropping?

If I had a few Bitter Beta scales I could create you quite the disguise!"

q3070024.giver_dossier:
# Quests of Gunther (Briarwood)

## Result: every quest Gunther gives is already built

Gunther (`npc_id` 9000000339, name_string_id 3082272307, Briarwood, `repo:prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/npcs/briarwood.json`) gives seven quests. All seven already have records in `repo:prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/fisherman.json`, so I built no new dossiers. The guide row is `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Briarwood.md:90`, and the job cluster is `notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Fisherman.md` lines 92-104 (rows 15-21).

| Quest (client title) | Title locale id | Built record id | Record evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fisherman: Hungry Chugs | 31742645 | 3070019 | fisherman.json:951, evidence cites Fisherman.md row 15 |
| Fisherman: Fishy Fungus | 2361775528 (guide cell) | 3070020 | fisherman.json:997 (row 16) |
| Fisherman: Ink Cod Ink | 1551424341 (guide cell) | 3070021 | fisherman.json:1043 (row 17) |

| Fisherman: Undercover | 3950823086 (guide cell) | 3070023 | fisherman.json:1139 (row 19) |
| Fisherman: VIP Fish | 409922 (verified in locale: "Fisherman: VIP Fish") | 3070024 | fisherman.json:1185-1228 |
| Fisherman: Say Cheese! | 409720 (verified in locale: "Fisherman: Say Cheese!") | 3070025 | fisherman.json:1231 (row 21) |

Only 3070024 (VIP Fish) is listed in the NPC's `quest_ids_given`. The other six come from the guide and the quest file.

The built VIP Fish record (3070024) carries these locale ids:
- title 409922, "Fisherman: VIP Fish"
- intro 409921
- description 409923
- end text 409924, which is also in the locale as the text "They're trying to catch a Golden Scaled Nettler? I thought those were extinct!" (409455 is a near-identical line in the Dooba chain)

It is `"enabled": false`, with no prerequisites, no objectives and no rewards.

Locale checks that matched the guide: 409521 "Gunther wants you to try and catch a Golden Scaled Nettler in Brambleback's Bayou." and 409597 "Reel in a Golden Scaled Nettler" are the VIP Fish objective lines. 409726 "Take your catch to Feldman in Sanctuary so he can take a picture with you and your Golden Scaled Nettler!" is the Say Cheese! hand-in line.

# Quests of Waterwings (Lakeshore)

## Waterwings (npc 9000000233, Lakeshore): quest dossier

Three quest lines are tied to this NPC. One is already in `quests/fisherman.json`, one is unbuilt and Waterwings-given, and one is a Glerga order that Waterwings only receives.

### 1. Feed the Ducks (unbuilt, Waterwings-given): the main dossier

**Title:** locale **73289** "Feed the Ducks". Dat hash 2876341520 (ucdt), with ugdt 3982777117 "Feed the Ducks". Guide: `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Lakeshore.md:127` lists it with title ids 1885782413 and 2876341520 and calls it a minigame label.

**Giver:** Waterwings, npc 9000000233 (`npcs/lakeshore.json`, record above). Location: streets of Lakeshore (NPC guide line 127).

**Intro / offer:**
- 74619 "Waterwings wants you to fend off some ducks by feeding them his hot pepper fish bait." (dat 281790141). Best candidate for the offer line.
- 73290 (description): "A gaggle of hungry ducks are roaming the streets of Lakeshore. Clear them out for Waterwings by feeding them some of his ultra-spicy spiralmint fishing bait. Watch out for Hanzo the dog. He'll protect his web footed friends!" (dat 2221701655).
- Which of the two is the speech and which the journal description is not confirmed.

**Steps, in order (inferred from objective labels):**
1. Accept from Waterwings (no separate accept line found).
2. Feed the ducks with hot-pepper / spiralmint fishing bait. Objective and action lines:
   - 1660316680 "Click on a duck to feed them some of Waterwing's spicy spiralmint fishing bait."
   - 1430505917 "Interact with a duck to feed them some of Waterwing's spicy spiralmint fishing bait."
   - 73449 "Feed the Ducks!" (dat 1885782413)
   - 74624 "Feed the ducks!" (dat 1277040809)
   - 117086 "Feed the ducks Waterwings' hot pepper fish bait! " (dat 397298356)
   - 73457 "Feed more ducks!" (dat 195643455)
   - 388242 "Feed even more Ducks!" (dat 120673684)
   - 73458 "Feed another group of ducks before time runs out." (dat 231465280)
   - The "more / even more / another group" wording suggests waves. Counts and the number of waves are unknown.
3. Hanzo the dog guards the ducks (73671 "Hanzo"; dat 2310062995). Hazard only; no mechanic is evidenced.
4. Return to Waterwings:
   - 73453 "Return to Waterwings" (dat 3937849930)
   - 73454 "Head back to Waterwings and click on him before time runs out." (dat 243981147)
   - 431034 "Head back to Waterwings and Interact with him before time runs out." (dat 3195824311)

# Quests of Helena (Stillwater Crossing)

## Helena (npc 9000000103, Stillwater Crossing): quest dossier

**Result: no unbuilt quest is evidenced for this giver.** Both Stillwater-chef quests Helena gives are already in `quests/chef.json`. The other three ids in `quest_ids_given` are in `quests/fisherman.json`, but their giver field points at this Helena, which the sources contradict (see the conflict below).

### Quests given by the Stillwater Helena

| Quest | Title (locale id) | Built at | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chef: Stillwater Inn | 116477 | `chef.json` id 3050015 (line 819), `giver_npc_id` 9000000103 | Built |
| Chef: Gavin Gone Missing | 116493 | `chef.json` id 3050016 (line 868), prereq 3050015, giver 9000000103 | Built |

Locale text for these two (for the builder's reference; nothing new to add):

- 116493 "Chef: Gavin Gone Missing". Intro 116492: "My assistant is gathering ingredients for me, but he's late..." Description 116494: "Helena's assistant, Gavin Greenpetal has been gone for quite some time. Search for him on the road heading south out of Stillwater Crossing."
- Evidence: `notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Chef.md:101-102` (rows S1, S2, with title ids ucdt 2218586113 / 2734608986); `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Stillwater Crossing.md:129-130`.

Both rows have empty `objectives` and `rewards`, and the reward fields are "unknown" in the guide. Those are gaps in the existing build, not new quests.

### Quests in `quest_ids_given` that are misattributed

Fisherman quests 3070040, 3070043 and 3070045 are built in `quests/fisherman.json` with `giver_npc_id: 9000000103`:
- 3070040 "Fisherman: Plenty of Fish" (title 409040), line 1941, prereq 3070039.

# Quests of Trina Turtledove (Snowhill)

# Trina Turtledove (npc 9000000492, Snowhill): 12 Days daily quests

## Quest-id conflict to resolve first
- The record's `quest_ids_given: [3070042]` is already built. `quests/fisherman.json:2034-2037` has id 3070042 with `giver_npc_id: 9000000492` (Trina), title_string_id 410109, "Fisherman: Fishing Frenzy" (guide: Fisherman.md, Cluster G, row 38). So 3070042 is not a 12 Days quest. Do not reuse it for the daily quests.
- No file in `quests/*.json` contains any 12 Days title ("12 Days", "Penguin Defense", "Snowball Fight", "Crafty Robgoblins", "Cookie") — the grep returned no matches. All 12 daily quests are unbuilt.
- The 12 daily quests have no server ids in the evidence. Any id you assign is `(R)`.

## Quest list (wiki, Snow Days page: `refs:freerealms-wiki/raw/bac80181bdc69d442930190b92c4d090ebe42ed30f00f35c583958b30f77a869.json`, section "12 Days of Holidays")
Day 1 Penguin Defense · Day 2 Snowball Fight · Day 3 Crafty Robgoblins · Day 4 Cookie! Nom Nom! · Day 5 Wintery Fishing · Day 6 Defend the Gifting Tree · Day 7 Snowhill Racing · Day 8 Nog Hog · Day 9 Snowhill Soccer · Day 10 Battle for Snowhill · Day 11 Snowhill Derby · Day 12 Abominable Invasion.
The guide (`notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Snowhill.md:198`) gives the same 12 names with keys (Day 1 3782324610, Day 2 2496759848, Day 3 3052466527, Day 4 2538276843, …). These keys are not in locale ids and I did not verify them. Day 5 (Wintery Fishing) overlaps the built Fisherman line; I did not select it.

The four picked (Days 1–4) are the clearest in the locale. Each has a title, a dialog line, an objective line and a return line.

---

## Quest A: Day 1: Penguin Defense ("12 Days 2013 - Day 1: Penguin Defense")
- **Title:** locale 441125 "12 Days 2013 - Day 1: Penguin Defense". Short header 441078 "Day 1: Penguin Defense".
- **Intro (offer):** 441079 "Trina Turtledove of Snowhill wants you to complete a game of Penguin Defense called A Fishy Situation."
- **Objective lines:** 441126 "Complete the Penguin Defense game, A Fishy Situation - Easy." · 441127 "Complete A Fishy Situation".
- **Return line:** 441129 "Return to Trina Turtledove".
- **Completion text:** 441080 "The latest group of penguins are really smart! Training them may take time, but due to your hard work today these penguin students are well on their way! Thanks for your help!" The speaker is not stated in the locale. I treat it as the completion line, but that is unconfirmed.

# Quests of Helena (Stillwater Crossing)

## Helena (npc 9000000103, Stillwater Crossing): quest dossier

**Result: no unbuilt quest is evidenced for this giver.** Both Stillwater-chef quests Helena gives are already in `quests/chef.json`. The other three ids in `quest_ids_given` are in `quests/fisherman.json`, but their giver field points at this Helena, which the sources contradict (see the conflict below).

### Quests given by the Stillwater Helena

| Quest | Title (locale id) | Built at | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chef: Stillwater Inn | 116477 | `chef.json` id 3050015 (line 819), `giver_npc_id` 9000000103 | Built |
| Chef: Gavin Gone Missing | 116493 | `chef.json` id 3050016 (line 868), prereq 3050015, giver 9000000103 | Built |

Locale text for these two (for the builder's reference; nothing new to add):
- 116477 "Chef: Stillwater Inn". Intro 116476 (per chef.json). Description 116478: "Business at Stillwater Inn has never been better! But Helena is short handed while her assistant is out gathering ingredients. It's a good thing you're here to save the day!"
- 116480 (Helena's cooking-lesson dialogue): "...I'll teach you how to cook Spiralmint Steak, then you can help me catch up on these orders."
- 116493 "Chef: Gavin Gone Missing". Intro 116492: "My assistant is gathering ingredients for me, but he's late..." Description 116494: "Helena's assistant, Gavin Greenpetal has been gone for quite some time. Search for him on the road heading south out of Stillwater Crossing."
- Evidence: `notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Chef.md:101-102` (rows S1, S2, with title ids ucdt 2218586113 / 2734608986); `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Stillwater Crossing.md:129-130`.

Both rows have empty `objectives` and `rewards`, and the reward fields are "unknown" in the guide. Those are gaps in the existing build, not new quests.

### Quests in `quest_ids_given` that are misattributed

Fisherman quests 3070040, 3070043 and 3070045 are built in `quests/fisherman.json` with `giver_npc_id: 9000000103`:
- 3070040 "Fisherman: Plenty of Fish" (title 409040), line 1941, prereq 3070039.

The Fisherman guide places these at Wintery Basin with a giver named Helena (`notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Fisherman.md:136, 139, 141`). The NPC guide says this is a different Helena, "treated as two NPCs; unproven" (`NPCs - Stillwater Crossi

Both rows have empty `objectives` and `rewards`, and the reward fields are "unknown" in the guide. Those are gaps in the existing build, not new quests.

# Quests of Murphy (Snowhill)

## Scope

Murphy (npc_id 9000000158, name_string 2087408527) gives these quests in the record and guide (`notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Snowhill.md:60`):

- **Fisherman: Snowhill Getaway** (title 1748570026) and **Fisherman: My Hut is Your Hut** (title 4291056686 / 3983317068). Both are already built in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/fisherman.json` (3070037 at line 1799; 3070047 at line 2271). Skipped.
- **Tilda's overdue-book errand** (1613887895). Tilda Timidleaf is the giver. Murphy is only one of three stops (Lakeshore, Snowhill, Sanctuary). Its objective is "Retrieve the overdue book from Murphy in Snowhill." (308421505). Not a Murphy quest; skipped.
- **Hot Springs problems**: the yeti noise, clean towels, and smoothie chain. Nothing in `quests/*.json` references these (searched for Murphy, Downey, towel, yeti, Hot Springs). They are unbuilt. The guide says their title is not proven.

Two quests are unbuilt and have some evidence. Both are Murphy-given errands. Their titles are not confirmed.

---

## Quest 1: Murphy's clean-towel errand (Murphy → Downey → Murphy)

**Title:** not proven. The locale does not name it. Candidate: none evidenced.

**Offer (intro) text:** not evidenced for Murphy's side. Downey's side has an offer line in the opening-* locale dumps, not in the client dat: "I'm running out of towels! Downey usually washes the dirty ones, but she hasn't been by today. Will you pay her a visit and fetch some clean towels?" (2578435210; `opening-harvesting-native-20261009T142624Z/locale/en_us_data.dat:67877`). This is Downey's line, not Murphy's, so it is not used as the intro.

**Objective and description lines (client `locale/en_us_data.dat`):**
1. Description: "Murphy has asked you to fetch some clean towels from Downey." (545298654; line 14459)
2. Objective: "Fetch some clean towels from Downey." (87765181; line 2271)
3. Objective: "Give the towels to Murphy at the Snowhill Hot Springs" (500911197; line 13312)
4. Objective: "Return to Murphy at the Snowhill Hot Springs" (523757242; line 13911)

**Completion text:** not evidenced.

**Steps (in order):**
1. Accept from Murphy at the Snowhill Hot Springs (giver npc_id 9000000158).
2. Go to Downey (npc_id 9500000743, name_string 965991377, Snowhill; `repo:prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/npcs/snowhill.json:12059-12075`). Her house is on Snowdrip Lane (client 3653979331 in the opening-* dumps only; the client dat has the towel line 87765181)

# Quests of Lenore (Snowhill) ## Result: nothing new to build for Lenore (9000000131) Lenore's only given quest, **Fisherman: Feed the Penguins** (quest id 3070048), is already built. Below is what the existing build holds, and where it is thin. ### Fisherman: Feed the Penguins (quest 3070048), already built - **Built entry:** `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/fisherman.json:2318-2365`. Giver `giver_npc_id` 9000000131 (Lenore). My poor penguins have had to wait longer than usual for their food. Could you feed them for me?" - Description (`description_string_id` 410275): "You brought more Blue Thornfin than Valinda could carry! She's asked you ever so nicely to feed her penguins for her." - End (`end_text_string_id` 410276): "Nice catches, indeed! I don't think I've ever seen such a large Blue Thornfin." - **Steps (from the guide, not in the build):** Lenore's cabin at Frostbitten Banks is the start. The player reels in Blue Thornfin there, then takes it to Valinda at the Penguin Training Institute in Snowhill and feeds the penguins. # Quests of Mustang Alli (Snowhill)

## Result: Mustang Alli (9500000759, Snowhill / Frost Ridge Speedway)

**Quests this NPC gives:** one, per the record (`quests_given_text`, `quest_ids_given: [3080002]`), the Kart Driver guide (`notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Kart Driver.md:50`) and `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Snowhill.md:127`. No other quest in the guides, wiki or Sanctuary cache names her as giver. "The Burden of Fame" (3080001) is given by Raina Rush; Mustang Alli is only a talk step in it.

**Already built, so skipped:** `3080002 Racing Tutorial` is in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/kart_driver.json` (record at lines 140-258, `title_string_id` 117323, `giver_npc_id` 9500000759). The Snowhill NPC record also binds it (`npcs/snowhill.json` ~28740-28760). No new dossier is needed.

I re-checked the built record's text against the locale tool:
- Title 117323: "Racing Tutorial"
- Intro 117327: "Every driver should have his license. Take to the track to learn the basics of racing."
- Description 117329: "Get behind the wheel and earn your license."
- End 117330: "Congrats! Now that you've completed the basics, you should race the advanced tutorial."
- Goal 1 139383: "Complete the racing tutorial"
- Goal 2 139204: "Return to Mustang Alli"
- Offer-list line 115511: "Talk to Mustang Alli to learn about racing" (the 2217784590 string the guide cites)

**Findings on the built record (not changed; for the builder to check):**
1. **Minigame id may be wrong.** The built record uses `minigame_id: 31` as a stand-in for the speedway race. `refs:Sanctuary-PS3-20261009/src/Resources/ClientActivityDefinitions.json:2023-2039` has an entry "Racing Tutorial", `Id: 1048`, `NameId: 117323`, `DescriptionId: 139383`, `Category: 16`, `DetailImageFilename: tutorial_racing_detail.dds`. Line 69 gives "Wildwood Kart Racing" (`Id: 62`) `TutorialActivityId: 1048`. So a retail tutorial activity id of 1048 is evidenced, and the built record's note "retail tutorial-specific minigame id is unrecovered" is out of date. Caveat: the `31` in that file is "Hot Springs Haven", so the id spaces may differ. The builder should confirm which id the server uses before relying on 31.
2. **Rewards are reconstructed, not evidenced.** The record's 5 coins and 30 Kart Driver job XP are both marked (R). The guide records "Rewards unknown".
3. **Numeric ids are local.** `quest id 3080002` and the objective ids are local batch keys marked (R), not retail ids.

locale:394346 "That shady looking dude over there is Linx Redline, and right now he's laughing at me for losing.

What a punk! That guy's a total cheater. He's been tearing up the track lately because he's using an illegal booster in his race kart.

You should disable that booster and challenge him to a race! Getting rocked fair and square would teach him a lesson!"
texts.end_text_string_id:
locale:394349 "Whoa, one second pal, back it up. I'm not into being seen with lowly rookies.

You might have beaten Verve, but that doesn't say much. That guy should have stuck to wrecking karts instead of racing them."

texts.description_string_id: locale:394435 'T.R. Walker Jr. has agreed to race you at the Wildwood Speedway. A victory against T.R. should continue to elevate your standing among the other racers.'
texts.intro_text_string_id:
locale:394433 "All right! Let's shake and broil!

Racing is all about speed. If you can't handle it, you ain't gonna amount to much. The track is going to have a lot of boosts lying around, so get ready to go fast!

That's how I roll out there compadre! You still game?"
texts.end_text_string_id:
locale:394436 "You were like greased lightning out there! I must have blown an engine gasket or something during lap two. I just couldn't seem to go fast enough.

You've got real talent. With a little experience, some kart upgrades, and a little luck, I think you could take a serious run at Kade Carmichael, the current SG Tour 400 champ."

texts.description_string_id: locale:394485 'You need to obtain a sponsor before you can challenge any more ranked racers. T.R. suggested talking to Blammo, a robgoblin at the Wildwood Speedway.'
texts.intro_text_string_id:
locale:394483 "If you want to make a run at the cup, you're going to need to get a sponsor. At the level you're at, without some sort of backing, you're not going to be taken seriously.

Try talking to that robgoblin, Blammo over there. I think he's here looking for some exposure for his club or something. He might be willing to sponsor you."
texts.end_text_string_id:
locale:394486 "Aren't you [*player*]? Excellent. I'm here representing the Robgoblin Exploder's League!

We're trying to establish ourselves as the number one source of explosive devices for robgoblins in the greater Sacred Grove area, and we could use a racer willing to let us exploi - err, sponsor them!"

locale:394495 "We don't want just any old racer. I need to make sure you're the best around.

Let's see what your times here at Wildwood look like. If you can't come in under the lap time I have in mind, this isn't going to work out.

I've made sure there's plenty of boosts on the track, so impress me!"

texts.title_string_id: locale:394663 'Kart Driver: Seaside Board of Tourism Sponsorship'
texts.description_string_id: locale:394664 'You need to obtain another sponsor before the racers at Thunder Falls will give you the time of day. It sounds like Petal Oceanmist at Frost Ridge Speedway might be someone to talk to about a potential sponsorship.'
texts.intro_text_string_id:
locale:394662 "Well, now that you've beaten me, I need to make sure you rise to the top so that my loss looks less embarrassing.

I've heard that Petal Oceanmist is looking to sponsor a racer. Having a second sponsor should be enough to get the racers out at Thunder Falls to give you the time of day.

Why don't you ask about it?"
texts.end_text_string_id:
locale:394665 "Brrr! It's cold out here! It makes me long for the warm sun, gentle sea breezes, and beautiful vistas of Seaside.

I work for the Seaside Board of Tourism, and I'm looking to sponsor a racer to help let people know Seaside is the best vacation destination around!

You think you're the right racer for us to sponsor?"

texts.description_string_id: locale:394711 "It's time to land a new sponsor! Chase has informed you that Shooblemoot at Thunder Falls represents a pretty famous brand: the one and only Sweetwater Sasparilla! He might be in a position to sponsor a driver."
texts.intro_text_string_id:
locale:394709 "Unlike Linx, I don't have any sour grapes after a loss. I think you've got what it takes to go the distance if you keep at it, but you'll need another sponsor before you can move to Tangletrack.

Check with Shooblemoot. He represents the Sweetwater Sasparilla Brewery. You might be able to help each other out."
texts.end_text_string_id:
locale:394712 "[*player*]! I was hoping we'd run into each other. I represent the Sweetwater Brewery, makers of Sweetwater Sasparilla!

I'm here to see about getting a racer to support our product, and you're the racer everyone is talking about. Maybe we can work something out?"

The other two are in `quests/kart_driver.json` as stubs (3080027, 3080028) with `objectives: []`, `rewards: []`, `enabled: false`, so I treat all three as unbuilt. Their giver is recorded as `9000000271` (see Gaps). Stub giver is 9000000271 (conflict, see Gaps). - **Prerequisite:** Kart Driver: Settling the Score (3080026, title 3528; `kart_driver.json:1295`). Guide row 25 says "After Settling the Score". q3080038.giver_dossier:
# Quests of Mirana Vega (Briarwood)

## Summary

Mirana Vega (npc 9000000409, `npcs/briarwood.json`) gives two quests. Both already have entries in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/kart_driver.json`, so no new quest dossier is needed. Both entries are stubs: objectives and rewards are empty. The dossier below records what is evidenced for the builder to finish them.

## Quest 1: Kart Driver: The Keys to Victory (built as 3080038)

- **Title:** locale 395301 "Kart Driver: The Keys to Victory"; also ucdt 1691606938 and ugdt 2033785101.
- **Giver:** npc 9000000409, Mirana Vega. Matches the stub (`kart_driver.json:1833`).
- **Built entry:** `kart_driver.json:1830-1875`. `objectives: []`, `rewards: []`, `enabled: false`.
- **Candidate text ids in the stub:** intro 395300, description 395302, end 395303. These were filled by a T-1/T+1/T+2 guess around the title, not by a match on content.
  - 395302 "Mirana Vega is the last racer ranked between you and Kade Carmichael, the current champion. Do what you can to set up a race against her." Reads like a description, but it is about racing, not keys.
  - 395303 "Awesome! You're a life saver! ... You're [*player*], the Kart Driver, right?" Reads like a completion line for the key-finding task.
  - 395300 "Honestly, I wish you the best... Talk to her and see if you can set up a race." Its text is the same as ucdt 1518889595, which the guide ties to Linx Redline's The Showdown. So 395300 is probably **not** this quest's intro. The stub's intro id looks wrong.
- **Objective candidates (locale):**
  - 565302289 "Help Mirana Vega find her lost keys near Tangletrack Speedway." (offer or objective)
  - 1115567718 / 395455 "Beat "The Keys to Victory" minigame" (objective)
- **Steps (evidenced in part):** talk to Mirana, help find her keys near Tangletrack Speedway, then beat "The Keys to Victory" minigame. The order is inferred from the guide (`notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Kart Driver.md`, row 36, which marks it "inferred").
- **Prerequisites:** the guide says "before The Right Stuff (inferred)". No level, job or quest id is evidenced.
- **Rewards:** none evidenced. Marked (R) by omission.

## Quest 2: Kart Driver: The Right Stuff (built as 3080039)

- **Title:** locale 3583 "Kart Driver: The Right Stuff"; also ucdt 509182203 and 1698693843 and ugdt 783654493.
- **Giver:** the stub lists `giver_npc_id: 9000000152` (`kart_driver.json:1879`). This record lists Mirana Vega, 9000000409, as the giver. No NPC with id 90

(R) T197: row 1 reward cell is unknown. Five coins use the existing W110/T194 small-referral fallback and 15 Medic (profile 11) job XP follows the same policy. The guide's Student Medic Hammer belongs to unlocking the job, not to this quest's reward cell, so no item is inferred.

q3090001.giver_dossier:
# Quests of Nurse Naia (Sanctuary)

## Summary

Nurse Naia (9000000161) gives five quests in the Medic line. All five already have records in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/medic.json`:

| id | Quest | Record state |
|---|---|---|
| 3090001 | So You Want to be a Medic? (title 2991926009) | Built, enabled, one talk objective. Skipped. |
| 3090002 | Medic: Operation: Revival (title 10164) | Stub: `enabled: false`, no objectives, no rewards, no intro or end text. **Dossier below.** |
| 3090003 | Medic: House Call (title 22989) | Built, enabled, one talk objective. Skipped. |
| 3090009 | Medic: Supply Recovery (title 73361) | Stub: `enabled: false`, empty objectives and rewards, and it has no `job` field. **Dossier below.** |
| 3090011 | Medic: Tummies in Turmoil (title 73752) | Stub: `enabled: false`, empty objectives and rewards, and it has no `job` field. **Dossier below.** |

Only three quests are unfinished, so the list is shorter than four. Every step below comes from locale ids I read, or from the guide's quoted client hashes. The guide hashes are not locale ids, so I matched them by exact text. Anything else is marked.

Chain as built: 3090001 → 3090002 (Operation: Revival) → 3090003 (House Call). Supply Recovery (3090009, prereq 3090008) → Medic on a Mission (3090010, giver 9000000488) → Tummies in Turmoil (3090011, prereq 3090010).

---

## 1. Medic: Operation: Revival (3090002), stub

- **Title:** "Medic: Operation: Revival", locale 10164. Guide title ids: ucdt 511442475 / ugdt 3987711664.
- **Giver:** Nurse Naia 9000000161. Wiki and guide say Naia (`notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Medic.md`, Band 1 row 2).
- **Prerequisite:** 3090001 (guide "After 1"). The record has `prerequisite_quest_ids: [3090001]`.
- **Level/job:** guide says level 5 band. The record has no `job` field.
- **Intro (offer):** not confirmed. The guide quotes "Here's your chance to learn about First Aid while on the job..." (4068730179), but I did not find its locale id. Locale 15584 is a candidate: "Medic! What are you doing just standing here? There are some wounded bixies in the Bixie Hive that need your assistance!" It is not confirmed as the offer.
- **Steps:**
  1. Accept from Naia (intro as above).
  2. Go into the Bixie Hive (Queensfields, per guide; dungeon locale 5702 "Bixie Hive") and **revive twelve wounded bixies**. Description, locale 15586: "You are to go into the Bixie Hive and revive twelve wounded bixies. I cannot go, I must stay at the hospital. Now h

# Quests of Nurse Naia (Sanctuary)

## Summary

Nurse Naia (9000000161) gives five quests in the Medic line. All five already have records in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/medic.json`:

| id | Quest | Record state |
|---|---|---|
| 3090001 | So You Want to be a Medic? (title 2991926009) | Built, enabled, one talk objective. Skipped. |
| 3090002 | Medic: Operation: Revival (title 10164) | Stub: `enabled: false`, no objectives, no rewards, no intro or end text. **Dossier below.** |
| 3090003 | Medic: House Call (title 22989) | Built, enabled, one talk objective. Skipped. |
| 3090009 | Medic: Supply Recovery (title 73361) | Stub: `enabled: false`, empty objectives and rewards, and it has no `job` field. **Dossier below.** |
| 3090011 | Medic: Tummies in Turmoil (title 73752) | Stub: `enabled: false`, empty objectives and rewards, and it has no `job` field. **Dossier below.** |

Nurse Naia (9000000161) gives five quests in the Medic line. All five already have records in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/medic.json`:

A builder should decide the giver; I did not change anything.

## Docaloc (npc 9000000071): quest dossier

**Triage.** Docaloc's record lists 7 quests. Medic: Into the Bristlewood is 3090018 (title 74064, `:1080`), but its giver is 9000000143 (Mayor Crystalline), not Docaloc. These six are skipped.

Caveat for the builder: the five built Docaloc records have `"objectives": []` and `"rewards": []`. They hold title and intro/description/end ids only, so "built" here means the shell exists, not that its steps are filled in. I did not re-audit them.

Only one Docaloc quest is unbuilt: **Medic: Night of the Shamblers**. It has no record in `quests/*.json` (searched for its title hashes 212414339 / 3986581811 and the locale id 420514).

- The NPC record's `quests_given_text` and `quest_ids_given` (sanctuary.json:12915 onward, and the list at :13127) name 3090012, 3090013, 3090015 and 3090025.

- The wiki Doctor Gordon page (`refs`: freerealms-wiki/wikitext/2368-50187-35a8d54a97a0.wiki) lists Omitted Admission in his appearances. Wiki Clover list (2098-49729 .wiki lines 57–71) names Clover's Crisis, A Strong Supplement, Shocking Developments and Omitted Admission.
- Locale: 73783 "Medic: Clover's Crisis" (ucdt 2312387900), 387532 "Medic: Achieve Level 10" (the ucdt hash 58421768 was corrected to this id in the record), 74768 "Medic: Shocking Developments", 74783 "Medic: Omitted Admission". No locale string matches "A Strong Supplement" (locale search returned none).

## Gaps

- **Omitted Admission (3090026) giver is unresolved.** The build sets `giver_npc_id` to 9000000280, which `npcs_unresolved.json:2051` lists as "Clover (wiki). The client text reads as Gordon". A builder should decide the giver; I did not change anything.

**Medic: Omitted Admission** (title 735775189 / 446557402) is also in medic.json as id 3090026 (line 1487). Its giver there is not Callahan. The guide's row 26 says it is given by Clover, and the client text reads as Gordon. Callahan only receives the letter, so it is not one of his quests.

## Result: no unbuilt quest for Sorin (npc 9000000472)

Every quest the record and the guides attribute to Sorin is already built in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/miner.json`. I did not write a new dossier, because the rules skip built quests.

### Already built, giver 9000000472 (Sorin)

| Quest id | Title (locale id) | Built at | Prerequisite in file |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3100006 | Miner: Reach Level 5 (387445) | miner.json:463-511, `giver_npc_id` 9000000472, intro 387444, description 387446, end 387447, `enabled: false` | none |
| 3100007 | Miner: Dartmoor Mining Camp (76971) | miner.json:513-567, `giver_npc_id` 9000000472, intro 76970, description 76972, end 76973, `enabled: false` | 3100006 |

Both entries have empty `objectives` and `rewards`. The title and text ids match the locale table:
- 387445 "Miner: Reach Level 5", with 387493 "Reach Level 5 as a Miner, then return to Sorin."
- 76971 "Miner: Dartmoor Mining Camp", with 76972 "Sorin wants you to take some of the turquoise you found to Shimmer Shinyaxe at the Dartmoor Mining Camp, and find more copper ore along the way. Dartmoor is located southwest of Snowhill." and 76982 "Deliver gems to Shimmer Shinyaxe at the Dartmoor Mining Camp."

Guide evidence: `notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Miner.md` rows 5 and 6 (lines 105-106).

# Quests of Ty (Lakeshore)

# Ty (npc 9000000223, Lakeshore): unbuilt quests

**Already built (skip):** the six ids in the record (3110001, 3110003, 3110004, 3110013, 3110015, 3110016) are all in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/ninja.json` (lines 5, 180, 232, 814, 915, 967), each with `giver_npc_id` 9000000223. Also built with Ty as giver: nothing else in that file. "Ninja: Return to the Mentor" (locale 769699029) is a Frostpetal quest per Ninja.md, not Ty's.

**Unbuilt Ty quests (3):** Ninja: Gathered Shadows, Ninja: Walking the Path, Ninja: Stilling the Waters. All three are on the wiki Ty list (via `notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Ninja.md` lines 134-140, and `NPCs - Lakeshore.md` row 39). None has a numeric quest id; the builder assigns one (R).

Ranking: Gathered Shadows first (most text), then Walking the Path, then Stilling the Waters (weakest).

---

## 1. Ninja: Gathered Shadows

- **Giver:** Ty, npc 9000000223 (Lakeshore). Trainer; ninja.json has the same giver for the other Ty quests.
- **Title:** locale 78909 "Ninja: Gathered Shadows". Title ids ucdt 907591037 / ugdt 2961875206 (Ninja.md:139; the ucdt hash is at locale dat line 24051).
- **Intro (offer), locale 78908:** "When the dojo fell, an instructor named Sarah stole my signet ring, a symbol of my authority. Sarah now oversees the group of Shadow Talon ninjas at Danger Peaks. Take the fight to them, and reclaim my ring." (font tags omitted here)
- **Objective, locale 78910:** "As a Ninja, fight your way through Danger Peaks and confront Sarah."
- **Other objective wording (same quest, not positionally confirmed):**
  - 91490 "Defeat Sarah"
  - 91491 "Defeat Sarah at Danger Peaks and recovery Ty's signet ring." (text as shipped)
  - 101550 "Defeat the traitor Sarah in Danger Peaks and recover Ty's signet ring."
  - 139523 "Sarah betrayed me and stole my signet ring.  You can find her in the Danger Peaks."
- **Completion, locale 78911:** "I am in your debt for honoring my request, but we have no time to dwell on your success. While you were gone, many Shadow Talon ninjas left the nearby Troll Fort. Lakeshore is in danger."
- **Steps:**
  1. Talk to Ty and accept (intro 78908).
  2. Go to Danger Peaks (dungeon; `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/dungeons/danger_peaks.json`).
  3. Defeat Sarah, the boss "Sarah the Traitor" (locale 130709; ugdt 593859555 / ucdt 2397611517). Target id unresolved.
  4. Return to Ty; completion text 78911.
- **Prerequisites:** Ty line only. Level unknown

# Quests of Ty (Lakeshore)

# Ty (npc 9000000223, Lakeshore): unbuilt quests

**Already built (skip):** the six ids in the record (3110001, 3110003, 3110004, 3110013, 3110015, 3110016) are all in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/ninja.json` (lines 5, 180, 232, 814, 915, 967), each with `giver_npc_id` 9000000223. Also built with Ty as giver: nothing else in that file. "Ninja: Return to the Mentor" (locale 769699029) is a Frostpetal quest per Ninja.md, not Ty's.

**Unbuilt Ty quests (3):** Ninja: Gathered Shadows, Ninja: Walking the Path, Ninja: Stilling the Waters. All three are on the wiki Ty list (via `notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Ninja.md` lines 134-140, and `NPCs - Lakeshore.md` row 39). None has a numeric quest id; the builder assigns one (R).

Ranking: Gathered Shadows first (most text), then Walking the Path, then Stilling the Waters (weakest).

---

## 1. Ninja: Gathered Shadows

- **Giver:** Ty, npc 9000000223 (Lakeshore). Trainer; ninja.json has the same giver for the other Ty quests.
- **Title:** locale 78909 "Ninja: Gathered Shadows". Title ids ucdt 907591037 / ugdt 2961875206 (Ninja.md:139; the ucdt hash is at locale dat line 24051).
- **Intro (offer), locale 78908:** "When the dojo fell, an instructor named Sarah stole my signet ring, a symbol of my authority. Sarah now oversees the group of Shadow Talon ninjas at Danger Peaks. Take the fight to them, and reclaim my ring." (font tags omitted here)
- **Objective, locale 78910:** "As a Ninja, fight your way through Danger Peaks and confront Sarah."
- **Other objective wording (same quest, not positionally confirmed):**
  - 91490 "Defeat Sarah"
  - 91491 "Defeat Sarah at Danger Peaks and recovery Ty's signet ring." (text as shipped)
  - 101550 "Defeat the traitor Sarah in Danger Peaks and recover Ty's signet ring."
  - 139523 "Sarah betrayed me and stole my signet ring.  You can find her in the Danger Peaks."
- **Completion, locale 78911:** "I am in your debt for honoring my request, but we have no time to dwell on your success. While you were gone, many Shadow Talon ninjas left the nearby Troll Fort. Lakeshore is in danger."
- **Steps:**
  1. Talk to Ty and accept (intro 78908).
  2. Go to Danger Peaks (dungeon; `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/dungeons/danger_peaks.json`).
  3. Defeat Sarah, the boss "Sarah the Traitor" (locale 130709; ugdt 593859555 / ucdt 2397611517). Target id unresolved.
  4. Return to Ty; completion text 78911.
- **Prerequisites:** Ty line only. Level unknown

## 1. Ninja: Gathered Shadows

- **Giver:** Ty, npc 9000000223 (Lakeshore). Trainer; ninja.json has the same giver for the other Ty quests.
- **Title:** locale 78909 "Ninja: Gathered Shadows". Title ids ucdt 907591037 / ugdt 2961875206 (Ninja.md:139; the ucdt hash is at locale dat line 24051).
- **Intro (offer), locale 78908:** "When the dojo fell, an instructor named Sarah stole my signet ring, a symbol of my authority. Sarah now oversees the group of Shadow Talon ninjas at Danger Peaks. Take the fight to them, and reclaim my ring." (font tags omitted here)

  - 91490 "Defeat Sarah"
  - 91491 "Defeat Sarah at Danger Peaks and recovery Ty's signet ring." (text as shipped)
  - 101550 "Defeat the traitor Sarah in Danger Peaks and recover Ty's signet ring."
  - 139523 "Sarah betrayed me and stole my signet ring.  You can find her in the Danger Peaks."

- **Steps:**
  1. Talk to Ty and accept (intro 78908).
  2. Go to Danger Peaks (dungeon; `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/dungeons/danger_peaks.json`).
  3. Defeat Sarah, the boss "Sarah the Traitor" (locale 130709; ugdt 593859555 / ucdt 2397611517). Target id unresolved.
  4. Return to Ty; completion text 78911.
- **Prerequisites:** Ty line only. Level unknown

locale:78892 "Hmm, Sakka's note sounds serious. I wonder...

Bring me a copy of "Ancient Evils: A User-Friendly Guide to Evil Artifacts". There's a crazy hermit living in the Misty Mountains that has one.

If I'm right, that book will be able to shed some light on the situation."
texts.end_text_string_id:
locale:78895 "Let me take a look at that book...

Interesting. I think these shards you collected from Ozymandias have a corrupting ability. It seems the Shadow Talon are using them to quietly sow chaos...

I'll know more once I have more time to translate the book."

# Quests of Zachery (Stillwater Crossing)

## Zachery (npc 9000000235, Stillwater Crossing): quest dossier

### What is already built

| Quest | Built in | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Become a Pet Trainer (3120001) | `quests/pet_trainer.json` (record 3120001, giver 9000000235, title 415141, description 415142) | Built. Skipped. |
| Pet Tutorial: Basics (3120002), Happiness (3120003), Training (3120004) | `quests/pet_trainer.json` records 3120002 to 3120004 | Built, but their `giver_npc_id` values are not Zachery's. See Gaps. |

So the only unbuilt quest on Zachery's list is his untitled town introduction. Its dossier is below. It is weakly evidenced.

### Quest A: Zachery's town introduction (untitled, unbuilt)

- **Title:** not found in the client. The guide's guess is the generic "Introduce Yourself" title (4206471822 `ucdt`, 1457871810 `ugdt`). That title is shared by the Stillwater version (Valerie, then Francis Panic) and the Cobblestone version (Samantha, then Ricky Danger). Using it for Zachery would be a guess. Treat the title as unknown.
- **Locale id(s):**
  - 116877 (text table id): the offer text below.
  - 116876: "Talk to Zachery" (objective; adjacency only, not proven to belong to this quest).
  - 116516: "Zachery" (speaker name).
  - 140331: "Zachery is near the Pet Adoption Center in Stillwater Crossing." (client hash 1114196202). This is a location line, not a title.
  - Client hash for the offer text: 1793019252 `ucdt`.
- **Intro (offer) text, exact (116877):** "Zachery is giving pet training lessons at the brand new Pet Adoption Center in Stillwater Crossing. You should introduce yourself to him, and maybe learn a thing or two about pets while you're at it!"
- **Objective lines:** "Talk to Zachery" (116876). This is the only objective-like line adjacent to the offer text. Its link to this quest is not proven.
- **Completion text:** none found. The lines "Return to Zachery at Stillwater Crossing" (140330) and "Zachery wants to congratulate you on completing his introductory course on pet training. Talk to him right away!" (140816) belong to the Pet Tutorial hand-back, not to this intro.

# Quests of Postmaster Vixie (Merry Vale)

# Postmaster Vixie (npc 9000000174, Merry Vale): unbuilt quest dossier

**Already built, skipped:** Postman: Missing Mail (3130012), Postman: Mail Mix-Up (3130013), Postman: And the Winner Is... (3130014). All three are in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/postman.json` (lines 578, 632, 682). Postman: Beautiful Bouquet is also in postman.json (line 741), but the NPC record does not list it for Vixie.

Locale ids below are the `locale` tool keys (for example 427010). The hash ids (`ucdt`/`ugdt`, for example 1564628231) are the client's own string keys, found in `client` `locale/en_us_data.dat`. The NPC record cites the hash ids.

Three unbuilt quests are evidenced. Two of them (Secret Admirer, Forget-Me-Not) are Festival of Hearts quests whose named giver is not Vixie. Vixie is only a step in them. Both are ordered first because they have titles and full step text.

---

## 1. Secret Admirer (title evidenced; giver is Jecca Ruchcups, Vixie is a step)

Her offer line is locale 427174 (ucdt 1121958750): "Jecca is sure someone as sweet as you has many admirers! She's suggested you check in with Postmaster Vixie to see if you received a forget-me-not."

- **Steps (in order):**

# Quests of Postchug Runalug (Wugachug) # Postchug Runalug (npc 9000000172, Wugachug): unbuilt quests Summary: Five of the record's `quest_ids_given` are already built, so they are skipped. Two unbuilt quests have evidence: **A Missing Postchug** (strong) and **Delivery for Rimpadun** (weaker, with the giver taken from the guide). The text is the locale table's English, cited by row id. The guide's hash ids (ucdt/ugdt) are noted where they are the only link. ## Already built (skipped) - Card Duelist: Parcel Recovery, id 3040021, `quests/card_duelist.json:1019`. - Postman: Jug Clean Up 3130020 (`quests/postman.json:998`), Postman: Sorting It Out 3130021 (`:1048`), Postman: Achieve Level 15 3130022 (`:1098`), Postman: Fair Warning 3130023 (`:1148`), all with giver 9000000172. - Postman: Where's the Sasparilla? is built as 3130019 (`postman.json:944`, title 130193). Its giver_npc_id is 9000000079, not Runalug, so the offer is Seaside's (Enve LeStamp per the Postman guide, row 16). Runalug only gives the PCA step (1317516993). ## Quest 1: A Missing Postchug (unbuilt; strongest evidence) - **Title:** locale 46549 "A Missing Postchug". Hashes: ucdt 2294107554 (per the wugachug.json record), ugdt 509086726 (`refs: FreeRealmsLocaleTools/.../data/en_us_data.dat:13554`). - **Giver:** Postchug Runalug (npc 9000000172). Evidence is by wording, not a quest record. `npcs/wugachug.json:12174` lists it as `quest_id: null`, `page_lists`. The guide: `NPCs - Wugachug.md:151`. - **Intro (offer), locale 46548:** "One of my postchugs was due back from Merry Vale hours ago! I hope nothing bad has happened!

Please go and find him, he should be on the road somewhere between here and Merry Vale." - **Objectives, in order:** 1. Locale 46550: "Find the lost postchug. He is somewhere along the road between Wugachug and Merry Vale." 2. Locale 46557: "Search for the lost postchug! He should be somewhere along the road between Wugachug and Merry Vale." (same step, other wording; the guide's hash 4280580861.) 3. Locale 46559: "Find the missing postchug" (objective title). Description, locale 46560: "The missing postchug was delivering a shipment of sasparilla to Merry Vale. Search for him along the road from Wugachug to Merry Vale." 4. Locale 46562: "Return to Postchug Runalug in Wugachug" (objective title). 5. Locale 46563: "Return to Postchug Runalug in Wugachug and tell him what happened to his missing postchug." (guide hash 2688819018.) - **Target:** the missing

# Quests of Jacque (Sanctuary) # Jacque (NPC 9500000497, name_string_id 7575, Sanctuary): unbuilt quest dossier **Id note.** The record's `343512814` and `752124044` are keys in the client `en_us_data.dat` (the `ucdt` text keys). The `locale` tool does not accept them. Its own ids are different, and I cite both where I have them. Jacque is the NPC whose name is 7575 (locale tool: "7575: Jacque"). **Built already:** The Great Scavenger Hunt (quest 3000200, `quests/scavenger_hunt.json`) uses Jacque as its host, so it is skipped. No quest in `quests/*.json` has `giver_npc_id` 9500000497. **Candidates from the record and guides:** The record and `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Sanctuary.md:51` describe Jacque as a delivery target and a cook-off dish source, not a clear giver. Only the first quest below has a giver voice tied to Jacque. The second has a partial text set. --- ## 1. Stop, Jacque, and Roll (Jacque's Secret Recipe / Jacque's Dinner Rolls) **Status:** Strongest candidate. Giver is Jacque by his own first-person voice. The structure is partly reconstructed. - **Title:** "Stop, Jacque, and Roll". Locale tool id **5100768**; dat key `3017427506` (`opening-anvil-placement-v1/locale/en_us_data.dat:79716`). Objective-style line "Help Jacque perfect his Roll recipe." (tool id 5100822). - **Intro / offer (Jacque speaking):** tool id **5100767**, dat key `1904919000` (`locale/en_us_data.dat:50189`): > "Shhhhh! # Quests of Henry (Farnum Farmstead)

## Dossier: quests given by Henry (npc 9000000104, locale name 19093 "Henry")

Budget ran out before I could check every neighbouring locale id, so the Wompugg thread below is incomplete. Two unbuilt candidates are written up. Nothing here has been added to `quests/*.json`.

### Already built (skipped)

- **Farnum's Free Advice**: title locale 391030, intro 391041 ("I'm just a humble farmer..."), line 391031 ("Henry Farnum has seen something special in you..."). Built as quest 3000026 in `quests/adventurer.json:2040-2060` (title_string_id 391030). **Mismatch:** that record's `giver_npc_id` is 9000000346, not Henry's 9000000104. Someone should check which NPC the giver is.
- **Soccer Star: Sidekicks Steal**: built as quest 3140013 in `quests/soccer_star.json:528-566`. The title id 407412 is correct (locale 407412 = "Soccer Star: Sidekicks Steal"). # Quests of Drill Sergeant Dewey (Snowhill) ## Scope Drill Sergeant Dewey (npc 9000000076, Snowhill) gives three line quests per the record and the Warrior guide. **3150001 Becoming a Warrior is already built** (`quests/warrior.json`, record 1, enabled), so it is skipped. Two unbuilt quests remain. Both exist in `warrior.json` only as disabled stubs with empty `objectives` and `rewards`, so the dossier below fills them in. --- ## 1. Warrior: Warrior Warm-up (quest 3150002, guide row W2) **Title:** "Warrior: Warrior Warm-up". Locale **77223** (ugdt 1775539410 / ucdt 1777367688 in the guide). **Intro (offer):** locale **77222**: "You think you know what bein' a warrior is all about?

Put a hurtin' on those Frostfang Snarlers in the mountains to the southeast." (The Dewey-voice hash twin is 937190059, same text.) **Description / objective lead:** locale **77224**: "Drill Sergeant Dewey wants you to practice on the Frostfang Snarlers! You can find them menacing the mountains to the western side of Snowhill." **Completion:** locale **77225**: "Good work out there! You taught those wild wolves a lesson they won't soon forget." **Objective lines (hash ids, ucdt):** - 1962735708: "As a Warrior, defeat the Frostfang Snarlers wandering the mountains south-east of Snowhill." - 2218766120: "Drill Sergeant Dewey wants you to practice on the Frostfang Snarlers! You can find them menacing the mountains to the western side of Snowhill." - 2857140979 / small id 388421: "Defeat Frostfang Snarlers in Snowhill." - 3693529699: "Having trouble finding those Frostfang Snarlers? They're near the mountains south east of here." - Short tracker forms: 3912700565 / 91274 "Defeat the Frostfang Snarlers"; 2505559730 / 93363 "Defeat Frostfang Snarlers"; 78092 "Defeat the Snarlers!"; 78093 "Knock out all Snarlers!" **Steps:** 1. Accept from Dewey (after 3150001). Offer text 77222. 2. Defeat Frostfang Snarlers in the mountains south-east (or west, see Gaps) of Snowhill. **Count: unknown.** Target: enemy "Frostfang Snarler", template id **3592** (NameId 78096), from the Legacy server's `Npcs.json` (refs/FreeRealms-Legacy/src/Resources/Npcs.json:14111-14117). This is a reference-server id, not a client-verified spawn id. 3. Return to Dewey. # Quests of Steele (Snowhill)

## Steele (npc 9000000208, Snowhill): no unbuilt quest to add

Every quest the record lists as given by Steele is already in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/warrior.json`. Per the rules I did not build a dossier for any of them.

| Quest | Locale id (title) | Built at | State in file |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3150005 Warrior: Achieve Level 5 | 387433 | warrior.json:276 | `enabled: true` |
| 3150007 Warrior: You Deserve Better | 70995 | warrior.json:418 | `enabled: false`, `objectives: []`, `rewards: []` |
| 3150020 Warrior: Steele is Useful | 71498 | warrior.json:1079 | `enabled: false`, `objectives: []`, `rewards: []`; prereq 3150019 |

The record's "Receives the player in" quests are not Steele's to give. They are already built under other givers:
- Warrior: One With Your Weapon is 3150004, given by Morninglory (9000000155), warrior.json:190.
- Warrior: Asking Old Folks is 3150019 (title 71480), given by Sir Whittington, warrior.json:1027. Its sanctuary.json entry (line 54863) names Sir Whittington.

### Locale text for the built Steele quest 3150020 (for a builder who wants to fill its empty fields)
- Title 71498: "Warrior: Steele is Useful"
- Intro 71497: "I remember now! Fastvi Frostflutter's weapon was shattered during his last battle. Legend says that the one who finds the weapon pieces and defeats Chillblaine in Frostfang Caverns, will summon Fastvi once again." This matches the wiki memory line (Warrior.md row W20, 687730370).
- Description 71499: "Legends say that if a warrior were to collect all the pieces of Fastvi's broken weapon and defeat Chillblaine in Frostfang Caverns, Fastvi's spirit will appear. Let's hope this works!"
- End 71500: "I have been waiting for someone with your skills, young warrior..."

The 3150020 entry's objectives are empty and it is marked `enabled: false`. The locale text above is the Fastvi-memory story. The weapon-crate lines in the wiki row W20 are not attached to it, and they are not evidence for this quest:
- 2436909019 "You better go catch those robgoblins if you want to get Steele's weapon crates back."
- 2572980746 "Retrieve the weapon crates from Robgoblin Initiates"
- 582698859 "Get the weapon crates from Terrence"
- 3874559517 (Terrence: "Doesn't Steele realize this is an inn…")

Those are locale ids from the client text table. The file's `source` entries cite the Warrior.md W20 row (title id cell 2853049443). I did not confirm the crate strings belong to 3150020 rather

locale:71232 "I'm so tired of making deliveries. I just want to stay here in Merry Vale.

Maybe my old partner, Aster, would be willing to help me out. I used to forge the weapons, and she put a touch of glamour into otherwise mundane armor.

I heard she was traveling on the road south of here, trying to get to some silly fashion show."
texts.end_text_string_id:
locale:71235 "Tumbolina wants me to deliver this crate of weapons to Snowhill? As if!

I've sprained my ankle and I can't get through this path because of those unruly thugawugs! Could this day get any worse!?"

q3150009.giver_dossier:
# Quests of Tumbolina (Merry Vale)

## Tumbolina (npc 9000000222, Merry Vale): no unbuilt quests

Every quest I can evidence as given by Tumbolina is already built in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/warrior.json`. No new dossier is needed.

### Quests given by Tumbolina (giver_npc_id 9000000222)

| Quest id | Title (locale id) | Built at | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3150008 | Warrior: Distracted (71036) | warrior.json:469-520 | built, `enabled: false` |
| 3150009 | Warrior: Too Distracted to Work (71233) | warrior.json:521-572 | built, `enabled: false` |

The only repo quests with giver 9000000222 are these two (`grep 9000000222` over quests/ returns lines 472 and 524).

- **3150008 "Warrior: Distracted"**: intro 71035, description 71037, end text 71038, prerequisite 3150007. Evidence: `notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Warrior.md` row W8; `npcs/merry_vale.json:30887` (intro line 71035 spoken by Tumbolina); `T316.md:93`. Locale 71037: "Tumbolina thinks she can fix the weapons if you get her tools back from Braldan Stoneaxe in Merry Vale."
- **3150009 "Warrior: Too Distracted to Work"**: intro 71232, description 71234, end text 71235, prerequisite 3150008. Evidence: Warrior.md row W9; locale 71234: "Tumbolina doesn't want to leave Merry Vale, and has asked you to convince her ex-business partner, Aster…" (the description, which is where the record's 857744776 comes from); locale 71228 is the crate-in-Den-of-Secrets step text.

### Items in the record that are not Tumbolina-given quests

- **Warrior: You Deserve Better** (3150007, title 70995): giver is Steele (9000000208). Tumbolina is only the weapon-pickup target. Already built in warrior.json:417-468.
- **Warrior: Knocking Some Sense In** (3150012, title 71265): giver is Aster (9000000243). Built in warrior.json:675. Tumbolina only sends the player to Aster (857744776).
- **Test on Tumbolina** (934442070): a Cudip "Potion Testing: Version 7.0" target, not a Tumbolina quest (`NPCs - Merry Vale.md` row for Potion Testing).
- **Cotton-candy hand-ins** (4129793011): part of the cotton-candy errand chain (Rimpadun's Plan), not a Tumbolina quest.
- **"Speak with Tumbolina" (71001)**: belongs to Dubawug's Birthday Surprises chain (3076, `refs:Lxzxrus-Free-Realms-Server/src/Resources/Quests.json:911-935`, giver GUID 100000002271 = Dubawug), not to Tumbolina.

### Gaps

- Warrior quests 3150008 and 3150009 have no reward data and no objective data in warrior.json (rewards and objectives empty, `(R)` on

Numeric ids in the record for objectives (3906118291, 3815545278, 1811945937, 2039252240) are **not** `locale` string ids. # Quests of General Glowlight (Sanctuary)

# General Glowlight (npc 9000000097, Sanctuary): quest dossier

**Scope.** The record's `quests_given_text` names five titles plus targets. The wiki NPC page (`refs: freerealms-wiki/wikitext/18588-49946-9986f1ee9341.wiki`, lines 12-24) lists three as his own quests: Finding Facts About Fastvi, Where is Everyone?, Cakey Madness (repeatable). The other titles are not his to give (see the end). No quest file in `repo: prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/` matches any of these titles, and nothing matches `3150015`. So all three are unbuilt.

**Title ids.** The locale tool did not resolve the `ucdt`/`ugdt` ids I used (`1312962408` and so on). I cite the `client: locale/en_us_data.dat` line and its first column instead. The numeric ids the record's `quest_ids_given` uses are not evidenced to any of these titles.

(locale id `3761956869`, per Warrior.md line 106; not re-verified in the dat file).

# Quests of Steele (Snowhill)

## Steele (npc 9000000208, Snowhill): no unbuilt quest to add

Every quest the record lists as given by Steele is already in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/warrior.json`. Per the rules I did not build a dossier for any of them.

| Quest | Locale id (title) | Built at | State in file |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3150005 Warrior: Achieve Level 5 | 387433 | warrior.json:276 | `enabled: true` |
| 3150007 Warrior: You Deserve Better | 70995 | warrior.json:418 | `enabled: false`, `objectives: []`, `rewards: []` |
| 3150020 Warrior: Steele is Useful | 71498 | warrior.json:1079 | `enabled: false`, `objectives: []`, `rewards: []`; prereq 3150019 |

The record's "Receives the player in" quests are not Steele's to give. They are already built under other givers:
- Warrior: One With Your Weapon is 3150004, given by Morninglory (9000000155), warrior.json:190.
- Warrior: Asking Old Folks is 3150019 (title 71480), given by Sir Whittington, warrior.json:1027. Its sanctuary.json entry (line 54863) names Sir Whittington.

### Locale text for the built Steele quest 3150020 (for a builder who wants to fill its empty fields)
- Title 71498: "Warrior: Steele is Useful"
- Intro 71497: "I remember now! Fastvi Frostflutter's weapon was shattered during his last battle. Legend says that the one who finds the weapon pieces and defeats Chillblaine in Frostfang Caverns, will summon Fastvi once again." This matches the wiki memory line (Warrior.md row W20, 687730370).
- Description 71499: "Legends say that if a warrior were to collect all the pieces of Fastvi's broken weapon and defeat Chillblaine in Frostfang Caverns, Fastvi's spirit will appear. Let's hope this works!"
- End 71500: "I have been waiting for someone with your skills, young warrior..."

The 3150020 entry's objectives are empty and it is marked `enabled: false`. The locale text above is the Fastvi-memory story. The weapon-crate lines in the wiki row W20 are not attached to it, and they are not evidence for this quest:
- 2436909019 "You better go catch those robgoblins if you want to get Steele's weapon crates back."
- 2572980746 "Retrieve the weapon crates from Robgoblin Initiates"
- 582698859 "Get the weapon crates from Terrence"
- 3874559517 (Terrence: "Doesn't Steele realize this is an inn…")

Those are locale ids from the client text table. The file's `source` entries cite the Warrior.md W20 row (title id cell 2853049443). I did not confirm the crate strings belong to 3150020 rather

# Talespinner Yvelle (npc_id 9500000427, name_string_id 70613): unbuilt quests

**Id convention.** The `locale` tool's numbers are the table index (Global.Text.N). The ucdt/ugdt hashes in the NPC record and guides (for example 3376437174, 1226790271, 2800805012) are JenkinsLookup2 hashes and do not work as `locale` queries. q3160020.giver_dossier:
# Quests of Sandbur (Sanctuary)

## Result: every quest Sandbur gives is already built

Sandbur (npc_id 9000000190, name_string_id 2247542797, Sanctuary Inner Circle) is the giver of two quests. Both are already in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/wizard.json`, so no new dossier is needed.

| Quest | Locale title id | Built record | Giver in record |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wizard: Searching for the Past | 22364 | id 3160020 (wizard.json:1070-1119) | 9000000190 (Sandbur) |
| Wizard: Crystal Clear Delivery | 74972 | id 3160021 (wizard.json:1120-1171) | 9000000190 (Sandbur) |

Both match `quest_ids_given` in the record ([3160020, 3160021]).

### Not a Sandbur-given quest: Wizard: Filling in the Gaps

The record's text ("receives the opal gems in Wizard: Filling in the Gaps") names Sandbur only as the turn-in target. The quest is given by Iliya.
- Title: locale 74996 "Wizard: Filling in the Gaps". Intro 74995, description 74997, end text 74998 per the built record.
- Built as id 3160023 with `giver_npc_id` 9000000108. That id is Iliya in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/npcs/blackspore_swamp.json:15699-15705`.
- Guide: `notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Wizard.md:106` (row 21, "Iliya, Mire's Edge"). The guide's text on the gem hand-in is "Take the opal gems to Sandbur in Sanctuary." (3593443539).
- Sanctuary guide, `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Sanctuary.md:61`, also says Sandbur only "receives the opal gems."

### Other Sandbur-adjacent quests (not his to give)
- Wizard: Helping a Friend (built as wizard.json around line 1027) is given by Osgood. Its text sends the player to Sandbur, but it is not his quest.
- Wizard: Things Left Unfinished (built as 3160022) is given by Iliya.

## Gaps
- No unbuilt quest is given by Sandbur, so there is no intro, objective, completion, reward or prerequisite work to add.
- The built records have empty `objectives` and `rewards`. The guide has no evidence for rewards. Those gaps belong to the existing quest records, not to this dossier.
- Sandbur's record has no separate objective data for the built quests. Its quest ids are reconstructed batch keys, not server ids (see the `(R)` notes in wizard.json).
- Nothing was checked against the live server or community servers for these quests.

q3160021.giver_dossier:
# Quests of Sandbur (Sanctuary)

## Result: every quest Sandbur gives is already built

Sandbur (npc_id 9000000190, name_string_id 2247542797, Sanctuary Inner Circle) is the giver of two quests. Both are already in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/wizard.json`, so no new dossier is needed.

| Quest | Locale title id | Built record | Giver in record |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wizard: Searching for the Past | 22364 | id 3160020 (wizard.json:1070-1119) | 9000000190 (Sandbur) |
| Wizard: Crystal Clear Delivery | 74972 | id 3160021 (wizard.json:1120-1171) | 9000000190 (Sandbur) |

Both match `quest_ids_given` in the record ([3160020, 3160021]).

### Not a Sandbur-given quest: Wizard: Filling in the Gaps

The record's text ("receives the opal gems in Wizard: Filling in the Gaps") names Sandbur only as the turn-in target. The quest is given by Iliya.
- Title: locale 74996 "Wizard: Filling in the Gaps". Intro 74995, description 74997, end text 74998 per the built record.
- Built as id 3160023 with `giver_npc_id` 9000000108. That id is Iliya in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/npcs/blackspore_swamp.json:15699-15705`.
- Guide: `notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Wizard.md:106` (row 21, "Iliya, Mire's Edge"). The guide's text on the gem hand-in is "Take the opal gems to Sandbur in Sanctuary." (3593443539).
- Sanctuary guide, `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Sanctuary.md:61`, also says Sandbur only "receives the opal gems."

### Other Sandbur-adjacent quests (not his to give)
- Wizard: Helping a Friend (built as wizard.json around line 1027) is given by Osgood. Its text sends the player to Sandbur, but it is not his quest.
- Wizard: Things Left Unfinished (built as 3160022) is given by Iliya.

## Gaps
- No unbuilt quest is given by Sandbur, so there is no intro, objective, completion, reward or prerequisite work to add.
- The built records have empty `objectives` and `rewards`. The guide has no evidence for rewards. Those gaps belong to the existing quest records, not to this dossier.
- Sandbur's record has no separate objective data for the built quests. Its quest ids are reconstructed batch keys, not server ids (see the `(R)` notes in wizard.json).
- Nothing was checked against the live server or community servers for these quests.

# Quests of Sven (Briarwood)

## Sven (npc 9000000209, Briarwood): no unbuilt quests

Every quest that Sven gives is already a record in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/wizard.json`. Each record's `giver_npc_id` is 9000000209, which matches Sven's `npc_id` in `npcs/briarwood.json:64648`. I did not build or edit anything.

| Quest id | Title (client) | title_string_id | Record | Prereq (record) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3160027 | Wizard: Sven's Job Offer | 22321 | wizard.json:1429 | 3160026 |
| 3160028 | Wizard: A Twig From Treeleaf | 22353 | wizard.json:1479 | 3160027 |
| 3160029 | Wizard: One Thing to Bind Them | (see record) | wizard.json:1529 | 3160028 |
| 3160030 | Wizard: Reach Level 20 | 387671 | wizard.json:1581 | none |
| 3160032 | Wizard: Two Gems Are Better Than One | 76331 | wizard.json:1683 | 3160030 |

# Quests of Karin Spellweaver (Sanctuary)

## Karin Spellweaver (npc 9000000126, name string 22279)

**Quests this NPC gives:** one. The record's `quests_given_text` and `quest_ids_given` both list only **Wizard: Rescue Mission (3160033)**. The guide row agrees: `notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Sanctuary.md:62` and `notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Wizard.md:56` (row 31 at line 126). Karin is not named as giver of any other Wizard quest in the guide. Her other mentions are as the hand-in for the wand parts in one variant (`Wizard.md:223`, the Karin-builds-wand version) and as a name in other quests' text. Neither makes her a giver.

**Already built:** `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/wizard.json:1734-1785`, quest id 3160033, `giver_npc_id` 9000000126, prerequisite 3160032, `title_string_id` 76439, `intro_text_string_id` 76438, `description_string_id` 76440, `end_text_string_id` 76441, `enabled: false`. The same quest is referenced in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/npcs/sanctuary.json:34753` and `jobs.json:1529`. Per the task rule, it is not rebuilt here.

**Gaps in the existing build (not new quests):**
- `objectives` and `rewards` are empty in wizard.json. The file says so explicitly (line 1762: no free-text objective field, line 1774: reward values unknown).
- The rescue-mission steps (go to the Briarheart Caverns, rescue Sven, return to Karin) are only evidenced by locale lines cited in the guide (e.g. 3336946750, 3142750414), not by a recovered step list or target ids.
- No numeric server quest id exists in any source. The 3160033 key is a batch key (wizard.json:1754, marked (R)).
- The reward for the quest is unknown.

No other unbuilt quest is evidenced for this character, so there is nothing new to dossier.

# Quests of Cole (Seaside)

# Cole (repo npc_id 9500000567, legacy NPC 1748, Seaside Information Center): unbuilt quests

Cole's three quests named in the record are not in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/*.json`. A search for their title ids (1049406583, 3479015030, 3831948942) and for "Seaside" in that folder returned no Cole quest. The chain is: Welcome to Seaside (3020, prerequisite, not Cole's) → **The Oldest Building** (3021) → **Touring Seaside** (3022) → **Testing the Tour** (3023). All three are built below. Only community-server data (Lxzxrus, Sanctuary) gives the chain order, goals and rewards. The client gives the text, not the logic.

Legacy-id key used in the community data: `TargetGuid 100000001748` = NPC 1748 (Cole), `100000001749` = Brenna, `100000001756` = Seaspray, `100000004265` = Diggy (legacy 4265).

---

## 1. The Oldest Building (QuestId 3021)

- **Title:** "The Oldest Building", locale **93399** (also title hash 1049406583 in the guide, `ucdt`; `ugdt` 1548260977).
- **Giver:** Cole (repo 9500000567; legacy 1748). Giver dialogue 93398: "The Seaspray Inn was the first building ever built in Seaside. It's the foundation of all that we have here. Take a walk down there and say hi to Seaspray!"
- **Intro / objective text:** locale **93400**: "Cole wants you to visit the Oldest Building in Seaside: The Seaspray Inn." Description id 140222: "Cole in Seaside wants you to visit Seaspray at his Inn."

Seaspray's dialogue 93409: "Yep, my inn is the oldest building around, and still standing strong… you should probably head back, I'm sure Cole is waiting... plus it's time for my snack." A reminder line, 93413, says "Have you visited the Seaspray Inn yet? … It has a green roof!"

# Quests of Cole (Seaside)

# Cole (repo npc_id 9500000567, legacy NPC 1748, Seaside Information Center): unbuilt quests

Cole's three quests named in the record are not in `prototype/osfr-tools/data/content/quests/*.json`. A search for their title ids (1049406583, 3479015030, 3831948942) and for "Seaside" in that folder returned no Cole quest. The chain is: Welcome to Seaside (3020, prerequisite, not Cole's) → **The Oldest Building** (3021) → **Touring Seaside** (3022) → **Testing the Tour** (3023). All three are built below. Only community-server data (Lxzxrus, Sanctuary) gives the chain order, goals and rewards. The client gives the text, not the logic.

Legacy-id key used in the community data: `TargetGuid 100000001748` = NPC 1748 (Cole), `100000001749` = Brenna, `100000001756` = Seaspray, `100000004265` = Diggy (legacy 4265).

---

## 1. The Oldest Building (QuestId 3021)

- **Title:** "The Oldest Building", locale **93399** (also title hash 1049406583 in the guide, `ucdt`; `ugdt` 1548260977).
- **Giver:** Cole (repo 9500000567; legacy 1748). Giver dialogue 93398: "The Seaspray Inn was the first building ever built in Seaside. It's the foundation of all that we have here. Take a walk down there and say hi to Seaspray!"
- **Intro / objective text:** locale **93400**: "Cole wants you to visit the Oldest Building in Seaside: The Seaspray Inn." Description id 140222: "Cole in Seaside wants you to visit Seaspray at his Inn."
- **Steps:**
  1. Go to the Seaspray Inn and talk to Seaspray (legacy 1756; repo 9500000623). Objective locale **93405** "Talk to Seaspray"; **93406** "Pay a visit to the Seaspray Inn and speak with Seaspray." Seaspray's dialogue 93409: "Yep, my inn is the oldest building around, and still standing strong… you should probably head back, I'm sure Cole is waiting... plus it's time for my snack." A reminder line, 93413, says "Have you visited the Seaspray Inn yet? … It has a green roof!"
  2. Return to Cole. Objective locale **93407** "Return to Cole"; Cole's dialogue 93401: "I hope you enjoyed the inn. It's pretty peaceful there. I have more things to do if you are interested."
  - Visit event text: 93434 "[*Player*] has visited the oldest building in Seaside!"
- **Prerequisite:** quest 3020 (Welcome to Seaside). Next quest: 3022 (Touring Seaside).
- **Level/job:** not evidenced (R).
- **Rewards (community data only):** 30 coins, 80 XP, no items. (R) — client not checked.

Grab a cupcake
Return to Camellia
sections.Steps:
Speak with Camellia located in Sanctuary.
"Hey, <Player Name>! Did you grab a cupcake today?No? Well, you should!" -Camellia
Grab a cupcake
Select the floating tray of cupcakes near Camellia.
Speak with Camellia located in Sanctuary.
"Oh, you ate the last cupcake? I hope it tasted delicious!It looks like we'll need to pick up another order of cakes." -Camellia

quest2.detail summary: Arch Druid Camellia in Shrouded Glade has asked you to aid the dwarves of Sunstone Valley.

sections.To Start: Speak with Arch Druid Camellia located in front of the Druid Academy in Shrouded Glade.
sections.Goals:
Arch Druid Camellia in Shrouded Glade has asked you to aid the dwarves of Sunstone Valley.
Talk to Headmaster Merk
sections.Steps:
Speak with Arch Druid Camellia located in front of the Druid Academy in Shrouded Glade.
"Gus Geargrinder sacrificed everything to save us from the Gloam. Now we have a chance to repay him.A group called the Skullz has taken over Sunstone Valley, putting Gus' friends and family in great danger!If you want to help, find and speak with Headmaster Merk." -Arch Druid Camellia
Speak with Headmaster Merk located in Rumble Ridge in Sunstone Valley.
"Arch Druid Camellia sent you?That's great! The situation here is bad and we can definitely use your help." -Headmaster Merk

quest2.detail summary: Robgoblins aren't really known for their interest in anything that isn't junk, but Wheelie Pete happens to have a robgoblin regular that absolutely loves his Sunstone Sasparilla. Do Pete one last favor by delivering a barrel to Rizzle in the robgoblin scrap yard.
