sections.Requirements: Player must complete Quest:The Secret Ingredient Is... in order to do Quest:For Rizzle
sections.To Start: Speak with Wheelie Pete located in front of Wheelie Pete's Roadhouse in Sunstone Valley.
sections.Goals:
Wheelie Pete has asked you to deliver a barrel of sasparilla to Rizzle in Sunstone Valley.
Deliver the sasparilla to Rizzle
sections.Steps:
Speak with Wheelie Pete located in front of Wheelie Pete's Roadhouse in Sunstone Valley.
"Robgoblins typically only like junk, but I happen to have a robgoblin customer that loves my sasparilla.Could you do me one last favor and take a barrel to Rizzle? I would do it myself, but all that brewing really did a number on my back." -Wheelie Pete
Speak with Rizzle located in Whirly's Scrap Camp in Sunstone Valley.
"Whoa! Is that a barrel of Wheelie Pete’s Sunstone Sasparilla? Well give it here!*glug, glug*Ah, that hit the spot.?" -Rizzle

sections.To Start: Speak with Chugilda located in Bristlewood.
sections.Goals:
Chugilda has asked you to take Leddiwug and his men in the Trail of Betrayal their lunchboxes. 
Restock the Watchtower Provisions!
sections.Steps:
Speak with Chugilda located in Bristlewood.
My husband, Leddiwug, and his men forgot their lunches. Help rest​ock the provisions at each of the four watchtowers in the Trail of Betrayal. When you come back, my raven beak soup should be ready!
2.  Restock the watchtower provisions. 
-/4
3.  Return to Chugilda. 
Oh, back so soon? The raven beak soup is not done yet, so you will have to do without. But take this for helping out.

sections.Steps:
Speak with Dorn Geargrinder located in Rumble Ridge, Sunstone Valley.
"There're too many Skullz for us to face in a straight fight. It also doesn’t help that they're using Gloam artifacts.If we’re going to save Golmie we’ll need one crazy plan. Fortunately Headmaster Merk is one of those thinking types, I’m sure he’ll have a few useful ideas." -Dorn Geargrinder
Speak with Headmaster Merk located in Rumble Ridge, Sunstone Valley.
"Dorn shows his wisdom as a leader by not rushing in blindly to save his friend.From the little time I have spent in Rumble Ridge, one thing is apparent... no one likes the Skullz. I wonder if we could get the Sandscale Manguanas to help out." -Headmaster Merk

sections.Goals:
Tozer has asked you to deliver a picture to the post office in Seaside.
Take the picture to Enve LeStamp

Speak with Tozer located near the Seaside Information Center.
"I am really enjoying the view here at Seaside. In fact I took a picture to send back home. Only I don't know where the post office is...Would you be willing to take it for me?" -Tozer

"Deliver this picture to Tozer's family in Merry Vale? Sure no problem!" -Enve LeStamp

quest2.name: Helping Honeydew
quest2.detail summary: The baby horses in Skysong Glade are running around all over the place! Honeydew has asked you to help her bring them back to the nursery as quickly as possible.

sections.Quest Overview: This quest is given to you upon first talking to Honeydew. She is in charge of watching the baby horses and has lost track of them. She requests that you assist her in locating them so that they can head back to the nursery for the night.
sections.Instructions:: The ponies will be located in various spots around the immediate area. Upon finding one of the foals, you will interact with them, which will update the goal. Once you find all the horses, you will return to Honeydew for your reward.
sections.Honeydew upon first contact::
"Those little horses just won't sit still! Oh I wish I could get them back to the nursery... Wait a minute, you seem pretty quick! Want to help me?

The ponies are just playing hide-n-seek, so all you need to do is find them and they'll go right back to the nursery on their own."
sections.Honeydew upon finding all the baby horse:
"Oh thank you! I'm sure I would have been looking for those little horses all day if not for your help."

sections.To Start: Speak with Wheelie Pete located in front of Wheelie Pete's Roadhouse in Sunstone Valley.
sections.Goals:
Wheelie Pete needs your help finding his pet hog, Harley in Sunstone Valley.
Find Harley
Escort Harley to safety
Return to Wheelie Pete
sections.Steps:
Speak with Wheelie Pete located in front of Wheelie Pete's Roadhouse in Sunstone Valley.
"Harley went and wandered off again!I figure she went after the Sandscale down in the valley, but there's no way I can go after her with my bad hip. So what do you say, <Player Name>, will you bring Harley back to me?" -Wheelie Pete
Find Harley
Harley can be found in Sandscale Territory South-East of Sandspear in Sunstone Valley.
Escort Harley to safety
Protect Harley from the Manguana enemies until she is out of Sandscale Territory.
Speak with Wheelie Pete located in front of Wheelie Pete's Roadhouse in Sunstone Valley.
"That Harley is a real firecracker, but so are you, <Player Name>!I bet the manguana will steer clear of my place for a while, now that they’ve seen what the two of you can do." -Wheelie Pete

sections.To Start: Speak with Slinky located at the Seaside Luxurious Oceanfront Homes.
sections.Goals:
Slinky in Seaside has turned you into a monster to better scare the hiccups out of Cutes. Talk to him again if it wears off.
Scare Cutes Dozen to cure her of the hiccups
sections.Steps:
Speak with Slinky located at the Seaside Luxurious Oceanfront Homes.
"Have you seen Cutes today? She's got a really bad case of the hiccups! Poor girl... we have to help her!Now, I'm no expert, but I believe that the only way to cure hiccups is to give the hiccup-er a real scare! I have just the thing too!Find Cutes Dozen, and scare those hiccups right out of her!" -Slinky
Scare Cutes Dozen to cure her of the hiccups
Speak with Cutes Dozen located at the Seaside Luxurious Oceanfront Homes while under Slinky's Illusion that lasts 30 seconds.
If the illusion expires players may speak with Slinky to try again.
Tip: Use a pet with a speed boost.
"Ahhhhhhh!Wait...you're not a monster!Hiccups? I don't even have the hiccups!Slinky sent you? That meanie! Why is he always trying to scare me?" -Cutes Dozen

sections.Requirements: Player must complete Quest:Ka-Boom or Not To Boom in order to do Quest:Junk or Bust
sections.To Start: Speak with Rizzle located in Whirly's Scrap Camp in Sunstone Valley.
sections.Goals:
Rizzle needs you to get him some Scrap Yard Junk in Sunstone Valley.
Collect Scrap Yard Junk - /10
Return to Rizzle
sections.Steps:
Speak with Rizzle located in Whirly's Scrap Camp in Sunstone Valley.
"It's my boss, Whirly Willis. He wants junk or I’m kicked out!But where am I going to get junk? Every last piece is already IN the scrap yard... Wait a second. Are you thinking what I’m thinking? Great, then go get me some junk from the scrap yard.Please?" -Rizzle
Collect Scrap Yard Junk - /10
Scrapyard Junk are located all around the Scrap Master Fizzbang's Junkyard located in North-West Sunstone Valley
Speak with Rizzle located in Whirly's Scrap Camp in Sunstone Valley.
"<Player Name>! You won't believe what happend... I got promoted! Crazy, right?Willis was so impressed when I told him that I con- err, asked you to bring me some junk that he made me Chief of Junk Security!Now all I have to do is supervise a bunch of robots. There's just one problem..." -Rizzle

sections.Requirements: Player must complete Quest:It's Too Quiet... in order to do Quest:Rescue in the Ruins
sections.To Start: Speak with Sarkin Stonehearth found at The Dig in Sunstone Valley.
sections.Goals:
Sarkin wants you to rescue Assistant Bogse in the Precursor Ruins in Sunstone Valley.
Rescue Assistant Bogse
Return to Sarkin Stonehearth
sections.Steps:
Speak with Sarkin Stonehearth found at The Dig in Sunstone Valley.
"Wait... where’s Bogse? Oh no. The spiders must have grabbed him!<Player Name>, we have to save Assistant Bogse, but I can barely stand with this poison running through me. Please, you’re the only one that has a chance of finding him in the Precursor Ruins." -Sarkin Stonehearth
Rescue Assistant Bogse
Assistant Bogse is rescued by completing Precursor Ruins Sunstone Valley Dungeon.
Speak with Sarkin Stonehearth found at The Dig in Sunstone Valley.
"You saved Bogse AND discovered the greatest find I’ve ever heard of! Functioning Precursor artifacts? Unbelievable! Studying them may be a problem, but I’m sure we’ll figure out something.And <Player Name>, if you ever need anything from me or my crew, you just come back here and let me know. As far as I’m concerned we’re pals for life!" -Sarkin Stonehearth

Enter Robbie's Tent and click on the Robgoblin Junkpile inside the tent. Will automatically start and finish quest and get reward.
If repeated 7 days in a row without missing a day you can open up a chest buried inside.

Day 5 to Day 6, anything found in a Rare Robgoblin Junkpile.
Day 7, a random Station Cash Item, housing items.

quest2.detail summary: Because of Rizzle's skillful handling of the junk situation at the Scrap Camp, Whirly Willis promoted him to Chief of Junk Security! Now Rizzle spends his days napping while his Robot Gaurds protect the camp from would-be thieves. Unfortunatly the robots keep breaking! Help Rizzle keep his new job by fixing up his robots.

Cutes in Seaside has turned you into a monster to get back at Slinky. Talk to her again if it wears off.
Scare the pants off of Slinky
sections.Steps:
Speak with Cutes Dozen located at the Seaside Luxurious Oceanfront Homes.
"I'm not usually a mean person, but I've had it with Slinky! Will you help me get back at him?I found a potion that'll definitely scare the pants right off him! I can pour it on you if you'd be willing to scare Slinky with it." -Cutes Dozen
Scare the pants off of Slinky
Speak with Slinky located at the Seaside Luxurious Oceanfront Homes while under Cutes' Illusion that lasts 30 seconds.
If the illusion expires players may speak with Cutes Dozen to try again.
Tip: Use a pet with a speed boost.

quest2.detail summary: After defeating the Gloam in Shrouded Glade, Dorn Geargrinder has returned to Sunstone Valley to find it overrun by a rival biker gang, the Skullz. Many Freewheelers have gone into hiding and Dorn doubts his ability to reunite the gang.

sections.To Start: Speak with Dorn Geargrinder located in Rumble Ridge, Sunstone Valley.
sections.Goals:
Help Dorn Geargrinder by regrouping the Freewheelers.
Talk to Golmie Greasebeard
Talk to Headmaster Merk
Talk to Freewheelers - /3
Return to Dorn Geargrinder
sections.Steps:
Speak with Dorn Geargrinder located in Rumble Ridge, Sunstone Valley.
"It seems that while we was in Shrouded Glade, this gang called the Skullz took over Rumble Ridge. And now most of the Freewheelers have deserted! If only Gus was here..." -Dorn Geargrinder
Speak with Golmie Greasebeard located in Rumble Ridge, Sunstone Valley.
"Dorn's havin' a hard time acceptin' the loss of his brother Gus. He's a blasted hero and the only one that can pull the gang back together." -Golmie Greasebeard
Speak with Headmaster Merk located in Rumble Ridge, Sunstone Valley.
"Dorn needs to be reminded of the trust his brother Gus had in him. Gus knew Dorn was a natural leader. If you can find the other Freewheelers and tell them of Dorn’s accomplishments in Shrouded Glade, I am certain they would follow him." -Headmaster Merk
Speak with Freewheelers located in Rumble Ridge, Sunstone Valley.
One Freewheeler

quest2.detail summary: Yarith has given you medicine that will cure the Unicorns of their allergies. You'll need to take it to Silverspark right away. Hopefully she likes it.

sections.Requirements: Player must complete Quest:Gathering Evidence in order to do Quest:Sweets for Sniffles
sections.To Start: Speak with Yarith Yewroot located in Green Watch, Pony Vale.
sections.Objectives:
Yarith at Green Watch has given you a remedy for the Unicorns of Unicorn Forest. Use it to cure their allergies.
Take Yarith's Remedy to SilversparkYarith has given you a remedy to cure the Unicorns of their allergies. Take it to Silverspark in Unicorn Forest as soon as you can.
Find an expert on sweets near Skysong LedgeThe allergy medicine Yarith gave you needs to be mixed with something sweet before the Unicorns can eat it. Find a sweets expert near Skysong Ledge that can help you find the perfect sweet to mix with!
Bring Marzipan some Vanilla Ice CreamMarzipan thinks Vanilla Ice Cream will mix perfectly with Yarith's Remedy. Go buy some from Razzle the Robgoblin then bring it back to Marzipan for a taste test.
Bring Marzipan some Chocolate Ice CreamVanilla was a bust, but Marzipan is sure that Chocolate Ice Cream will mix perfectly with Yarith's Remedy. Go buy some from Razzle the Ro

quest2.detail summary: Rizzle wants to thank you for all the help you've given him, so he's decided to tell you about the famed Legendary Sunstone. Rizzle doesn't know why anyone would want a "Legendary Sunstone" but helping out the dwarf that's looking for it could earn you a lot of quality junk.

sections.Requirements: Player must complete Quest:Robot Woes in order to do Quest:The Legendary Sunstone
sections.To Start: Speak with Rizzle located in Whirly's Scrap Camp in Sunstone Valley.
sections.Goals:
Rizzle has pointed you at a strange dwarf in search of the "Legendary Sunstone" in Sunstone Valley.
Find Noggle Cogloose
sections.Steps:
Speak with Rizzle located in Whirly's Scrap Camp in Sunstone Valley.
"Wait, I know! I’ll give you information!Yes, this is really valuable. See, there’s this crazy dwarf with a whole bunch of junk, but he won’t let anyone touch it unless they help him find some “Legendary Sunstone.” Help the dwarf and you could be rich!" -Rizzle
Speak with Noggle Cogloose located in Noggle's Retreat, Sunstone Valley.
"You there, yes you with the face!You heard the news then? About my Power Crystals? Oh but of course you did! Who hasn’t really? That’s a much better question.Well, what are you going to do about it?" -Noggle Cogloose

Apparently he purchases the ingredient from Peace-guana Joe, the former leader of the Sandscale Manguana tribe, but before Joe will give up the secret ingredient he may need you to do something...

sections.To Start: Speak with Wheelie Pete located in front of Wheelie Pete's Roadhouse in Sunstone Valley.
sections.Goals:
Wheelie Pete needs you to help out a friend of his in Sunstone
Meet Peace-guana Joe
Pass out the Peace Flyer - /5
Return to Peace-guana Joe
Return to Wheelie Pete
sections.Steps:
Speak with Wheelie Pete located in front of Wheelie Pete's Roadhouse in Sunstone Valley.
"The last ingredient in my Sunstone Sasparilla is top secret! Only my old friend Peace-guana Joe knows what it is.Joe was the Sandscale boss before the tribe went crazy. Now he won’t trade with me unless I send him some help. Are you up for it?" -Wheelie Pete
Meet with Peace-guana Joe located in Sandscale Territory in Sunstone Valley.
"Hey man, you’re Pete’s friend right? That’s righteous dude.So here’s the deal. I’m trying to win back my tribe with these Peace Flyers. If you pass them out I’ll hook you up with Pete’s secret ingredient. Sound good?" -Peace-guana Joe
Pass out the Peace Flyer - /5
Pass out Peace Flyers to Peacefull Sandscales located around Sandscale Territory. There are guides and watch out for Enemies!
"All this fighting hasn't done a thing for us. I'm ready for peace!" -Peaceful San

quest2.detail summary: The recent manguana uprising has really messed with Pete's business, and theft isn't even the worst part! Pete hasn't been able to get a single drop of oasis water, which is a critical ingredient in his famous Sunstone Sasparilla, since the manguana locked down the oasis. Venture into Sandscale Oasis and collect some oasis water for Pete.

questprog.next: [[Quest:The Secret Ingredient Is...|The Secret Ingredient Is...]]

sections.Requirements: Player must complete Quest:Hog Wild Harley in order to do Quest:The Water Must Flow!
sections.To Start: Speak with Wheelie Pete located in front of Wheelie Pete's Roadhouse in Sunstone Valley.
sections.Goals:
Wheelie Pete would like some Oasis Water from Sandscale Oasis in Sunstone Valley.
Collect Oasis Water from Sandscale Oasis - /4
Return to Wheelie Pete
sections.Steps:
Speak with Wheelie Pete located in front of Wheelie Pete's Roadhouse in Sunstone Valley.
"I'd like to brew more of my famous Sunstone Sasparilla, but I’m out of oasis water! It’s a critical ingredient and those Sandscale manguana have been hoarding it.Think you can get me some Oasis Water from Sandscale Oasis?" -Wheelie Pete
Enter the Sandscale Oasis Battle found North-West of Wheelie Pete's Roadhouse
Collect Oasis Water from Sandscale Oasis - /4
Collect Oasis Water found in the Oasis along the path, Watch out for Jumping Cacti!
Speak with Wheelie Pete located in front of Wheelie Pete's Roadhouse in Sunstone Valley.
"Thanks for bringing me this Oasis Water, <Player Name>! I’ll make sure you get the first barrel of Sunstone Sasparilla I brew with it.But first I need one more ingredient." -Wheelie Pete

sections.Goals:
Captain Sunspark in Shrouded Glade has sent you to help the dwarves.
Talk to Gus Geargrinder
sections.Steps:
Speak with Captain Sunspark located in front of the Warpstone in Shrouded Glade.
"Because of this invasion, the dwarves may never get home. They came here looking for allies, but the druids turned them down. Then the invasion began, leaving them trapped with no one to turn to for help.If you want to help them, the person you need to talk to is Gus Geargrinder." -Captain Sunspark
Speak with Gus Geargrinder located in the Pet Park area of the Shrouded Glade.
"Captain Sunspark sent you...What, you think that gives you a free pass or something? I'm going to need more than that before I'll start trusting you!" -Gus Geargrinder

quest2.detail summary: A talking horse named Peppermint wants you to meet her friend Honeydew near Skysong Ledge.

sections.Quest Overview: There isn't much to this quest; you are greeted by Peppermint and then sent on to talk to Honeydew.
sections.Peppermint::
"Oh wow! You're a [*player_race*] right? It's wonderful to meet you! This is your first time to Pony Vale isn't it? Then you absolutely have to see Unicorn Forest, oh but first Skysong Ledge, that's where Skysong lives! He brought us all here you know, us horses I mean. He's so cool!

Oh right, Skysong Ledge, that's straight north and a little west of here. Hey! You can meet my friend Honeydew when you get there!"
sections.Honeydew after being sent by Peppermint::
"Hmm, oh hello there... now where did those baby horses get off to?

Oh my, I'm being terribly rude aren't I! I haven't even given you a proper welcome. Well, I'm Honeydew. Nice to meet you!"
